  <script>
    const categoryHashParam = () => {
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
      const params = new URLSearchParams(hash);
      return params.get('category');
    };

    const applyCategoryFromHash = () => {
      const category = categoryHashParam();
      if (!category || typeof window.quartoListingCategory !== 'function') {
        return;
      }

      const encoded = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(category)));
      window.quartoListingCategory(encoded);
    };

    window.addEventListener('hashchange', applyCategoryFromHash);
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', applyCategoryFromHash);
  </script>
